text:
alex: Heads-up — noticed our SDKs map 429 to RateLimitError but don't expose `Retry-After` consistently across languages. This leads to flaky client-side backoff and noisy retries.

marta: ugh, saw a customer hit this yesterday. Their Go client kept hammering for ~30s even though server wanted a pause. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

cheng: which SDKs are missing it? I thought python/node already forwarded `retry_after` in the exception object.

alex: python and node do, but java and go just give a generic RateLimitException with a message string. No structured field to base backoff on.

marta: can we standardize on an error shape like: ```json
{
  "name": "RateLimitError",
  "message": "Quota exceeded",
  "http_status": 429,
  "retry_after_seconds": 12,
  "retryable": true
}
```

cheng: that shape looks good. Also we should map 503 -> RetryableServerError with `retryable=true` and surface `retry_after_seconds` if present. 401/403 -> AuthError (retryable=false).

alex: +1. Another small nit: include both `http_status` and a machine-friendly `code` (e.g., `RATE_LIMIT`, `SERVER_ERROR`, `AUTH`) so users don't have to parse messages.

marta: agree. For SDK ergonomics we should:
- add typed exception classes that expose these fields
- ensure language idioms map nicely (e.g., Go error interface + accessor methods, Java checked/unchecked hierarchy)
- add example in onboarding sample apps showing backoff using `retry_after_seconds`

cheng: I'll open a proposal PR with the error contract and a compatibility plan for existing clients. Question: what about streaming endpoints that emit a transient 431/connection errors? Should we mark those as `retryable=true` too?

taylor: yes for transient network/protocol failures. We should have `category` => one of ["client_error","server_error","rate_limit","auth","network"] so consumers can decide.

alex: good call. Also add telemetry: include `error.code` and `http_status` in logs so we can correlate. 

sdk-bot: Created issue INF-4387: "Standardize SDK error contract: retry_after, http_status, code, retryable" assigned to @cheng. <https://redwood.internal/INF-4387|link> :white_check_mark:

marta: thanks. Cheng, LMK if you want an eng review from runtime + product on the mapping table. I can be reviewer.

cheng: will do. Plan: PR with spec + quick patches for node/python this week, then go/java follow-up next sprint. Will add sample app snippet as part of the PR.

alex: tiny suggestion for onboarding docs: in the quickstart include a `pseudocode` snippet showing `if err.retryable then wait(err.retry_after_seconds or exponential_backoff)` so customers don't implement naive fixed retries.

marta: agreed. That should cut down on noisy retries and help dedicated customers hit SLOs. :thumbsup:

cheng: cool — filing PR now.
